pr_title: fs: add support for minimatch overrides
pr_body:
This PR adds an additional `overrides` parameter to the `options` argument of `fs.glob`. This allows users to override the default `minimatch` glob options.

Fixes #52779
pr_comments: If folks want to expose minimatch's API details to Node.js users, why is there `fs.glob()` with a different API in the first place?
I also am not sure this is the ask in https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/52779 - see https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/52779#issuecomment-2090280411
I believe it more like to ask support for glob string or array in the exclude option.
Yes, that sounds like a better idea.

issue_context.title: Replacement for `minimatch`
issue_context.body:
### What is the problem this feature will solve?

It is great that now in Node 22 there is `fs.glob`. But it seems that also replacement for [`minimatch`](https://github.com/isaacs/minimatch) is required. Otherwise, I don't know how to use `exclude` function from `fs.glob` options, because it is a frequent scenario when I need to use some glob pattern to exclude files.

### What is the feature you are proposing to solve the problem?

I propose to export some helper that matches path string and glob pattern (maybe from `path` module). 

### What alternatives have you considered?

The only alternative I see for now is use [`minimatch`](https://github.com/isaacs/minimatch) package (or package that similar to it).
comments:
can you give an example of your use case?
do you mean something along the lines of `path.matchesPattern(pattern:string, path:string) => boolean`?

Yes, something like this. E.g. in Vitest docs you can see an example of [exclude](https://vitest.dev/config/#exclude) property in config. If I want to implement a similar approach in my CLI utility that is written in Node, I need to filter out file names that provides `fs.glob` for me. Unfortunately, I don't see any way how I can do this using current Node API.

Also, I am developing [Karakum](https://github.com/karakum-team/karakum) project. It also CLI util, I use it to convert Typescript definitions to Kotlin/JS definitions. And I also have a similar problem: I need to collect some files using globs, but then I need to ignore some of them (also using glob). Now I use [glob](https://github.com/isaacs/node-glob) and [minimatch](https://github.com/isaacs/minimatch) libraries for it. I considered using native Node API, but I realized that I don't have a replacement for [minimatch](https://github.com/isaacs/minimatch).

BTW, thanks for asking.
@RedYetiDev are you interested in picking this up and adding a `path.isMatch`/`path.matchesPattern` helper?
